description: Codex hook wiring for the continuous-learning skill. UserPromptSubmit injects a one-line reminder; Stop forces a brief retrospective before exit.

UserPromptSubmit.name: continuous-learning-prompt-reminder
UserPromptSubmit.description: Inject a short reminder that reusable, verified learnings should be captured before ending the task.

Stop.name: continuous-learning-stop-retrospective
Stop.description: Require a brief retrospective: invoke continuous-learning or emit `No reusable learning.` to exit.

notes: PLUGIN_DIR is set by the Codex plugin loader to the absolute path of this plugin bundle.
Both hooks fail open (on_error=ignore): a hook crash must never break the user's session.
PostToolUse gating is intentionally NOT included in v1. See SKILL.md > Notes for the planned refinement.
